clues.text: Goliath, the Philistine champion who defied Saul's army in the Valley of Elah, came from this city.
When the ark troubled Ashdod, the Philistine rulers moved it here, and tumors broke out among its men.
Fleeing Saul, David came before this city's king Achish and pretended to be insane, drooling on his beard.
David and his six hundred men settled in this Philistine city, so Saul stopped searching for him.
In his lament for Saul and Jonathan, David said the news must not be told in this city.
In a battle at this city, a huge man with six fingers on each hand taunted Israel.
Shimei broke Solomon's order to stay in Jerusalem when he rode to this city to fetch runaway slaves.

taken: This champion came out from the Philistine camp standing six cubits and a span in height.
